# Embedded emissions cannot be calculated yet

The **country of production** is missing. The email says it is on a mill certificate that was not included. The ruleset selects the default SEE by both CN code and country, and says not to estimate when a required input is missing.

## Input check

| Required input | Status |
|---|---|
| (a) CN code in table | ✅ 7207 11 90 (semi-finished products of iron or non-alloy steel) |
| (b) Country of production | ❌ Not provided (on a mill certificate not received) |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | ✅ 3,300 t |

## Why country matters

The default SEE for CN 7207 11 90 differs by country:

| Country | Default SEE (tCO2e/t) |
|---|---|
| Türkiye | 3.087 |
| China | 3.314 |
| India | 4.32 |

The result could differ by about 40% depending on the country, so no figure is given until it is confirmed.

## Next step

Please send the **mill certificate** or confirm the **country of production**. If the country is not Türkiye, China or India, there is no default value for it in this table, and the calculation cannot be done under this ruleset.

Once confirmed, the calculation will be:

> **Embedded emissions (tCO2e) = Default SEE (country, CN 7207 11 90) × 3,300 t**, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
